layers.deciding_comparison: No finalized clean-install selection; this is unresolved evidence, not a demonstrated performance tie. Compare OpenLIT behind one Collector privacy gate against Collector + Prometheus + Loki + Grafana + Phoenix on the WSL2 host. Run the same real Claude Code and Codex task, reconcile native counters with telemetry, check duplicate capture and synthetic-secret leakage, and measure outcome coverage, overhead and restart recovery. If local inference is needed, compare llama.cpp, vLLM and SGLang using the actual task, matched model/precision/context/concurrency, output acceptance criteria, latency, memory fit and failure recovery.
evidence_gaps: The mandated ctx_fetch_and_index tool was rejected because it requires approval while this session's policy is never. No full page was fetched or read through ctx_search; documentation findings are primary-source search excerpts.
Budget correction: 30 GitHub API calls were used. Nine search queries across four calls exceeded the six-query limit. Further requests stopped; zero page fetches succeeded.
No upstream CI result, completed test-suite result or current benchmark separated complete observation stacks. Promtool documentation describes testing facilities, not a verified passing run.

All 14 repository metadata responses reported unarchived. Default-branch commits and latest releases were verified for eight candidates; pushed_at alone was not treated as default-branch freshness for the remaining six.

The eight fully checked candidates had recent commits and releases within the 90-day window ending October 1, 2026 in America/New_York. Open issue counts include pull requests and do not establish issue-response activity.
Linux x86_64 under WSL2, macOS arm64 support, release-pinned installation commands and end-to-end client integration were not comprehensively verified.
No optional model route is qualified. The available llama.cpp/vLLM comparison does not match the actual workload and omits SGLang.
